methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected directly from each vendor's official pricing page where accessible, or from a clearly-cited reputable comparison source where the vendor page returned a non-200 status or disclosed no prices. All prices are recorded at the monthly-billing rate; where a vendor only publishes an annual rate, the annualized monthly equivalent is used and notes document the annual total. annualDiscountPct is computed from the published monthly vs annual-plan monthly rate where both are disclosed, else null. Quote-only / contact-sales tiers carry null monthlyUsd. Telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null on every plan because this is a non-telephony vertical. accessedAt is 2026-06-14 on every source.

vendors.name: Greenhouse
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page at greenhouse.com/pricing confirms all three plans are quote-only with no published USD figures. Corroborated by softwareadvice.com which also lists 'pricing available upon request'.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Quote-only. Greenhouse states pricing is customized based on company hiring needs, volume, and organizational complexity. Contact sales or request a demo for a quote.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Quote-only. Adds optimization and operational features beyond Core. Pricing available upon request.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Quote-only. Highest tier for managing complex, high-volume hiring. Pricing available upon request.

vendors.name: Lever
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page at lever.co/pricing and lever.co/pricing/ confirm all plans are quote-only with no published USD figures. The page states pricing is 'available upon request' and tailored to organization size and hiring needs. Corroborated by softwareadvice.com which lists 'pricing available upon request' and two plan names: LeverTRM and LeverTRM for Enterprise.

plans.name: LeverTRM
plans.notes: Quote-only. Lever's combined ATS + CRM (Talent Relationship Management) platform. Flexible pricing scales with team size and hiring needs. Contact sales for a custom quote.

plans.name: LeverTRM for Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Enterprise tier with advanced features for large organizations. Pricing available upon request.

vendors.name: Workable
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page at workable.com/pricing confirmed Standard $299/mo, Premier $599/mo, Enterprise $719/mo for companies with 1-20 employees. All three plans display the same rate whether billed monthly or annually (annual total equals monthly rate x 12). The page advertises 'save up to 20%' when bundling recruiting and HR modules, not a billing-period discount. Corroborated by getapp.com and softwareadvice.com which both confirm the same three price points.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $299/month for 1-20 employees. Includes AI-powered sourcing, job posting to 200+ boards, collaborative hiring, and optional add-ons (Texting+, Video interviews+, Assessments+). Price scales with employee count. Annual plan available at same monthly rate ($3,588/year). 15-day free trial available.

plans.name: Premier
plans.notes: $599/month for 1-20 employees. Includes all Standard features plus Texting+, Video interviews+, Assessments+ as standard inclusions, plus dedicated account manager and custom report builder.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $719/month for 1-20 employees. Includes all Premier features plus performance reviews, advanced HR analytics, and enterprise-grade controls. Price scales with employee count.

vendors.name: Breezy HR
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page at breezy.hr/pricing confirmed all plan prices for both monthly and annual billing. Annual plan includes 2 months free (~17% discount). Corroborated by softwareadvice.com and getapp.com which confirm the same price points.

plans.name: Bootstrap
plans.notes: Free forever plan. Unlimited candidates, unlimited users, customer support included. Basic ATS features for trying out Breezy.

plans.name: Startup
plans.notes: Annual billing: $157/month (billed as $1,884/year, includes 2 months free). Month-to-month: $189/month. For small teams hiring regularly. Unlimited users and candidates. Add-ons available separately.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Annual billing: $273/month (billed as $3,276/year, includes 2 months free). Month-to-month: $329/month. Most popular plan for scaling teams. Unlimited users and candidates.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Annual billing: $439/month (billed as $5,268/year, includes 2 months free). Month-to-month: $529/month. For high-volume hiring. Unlimited users and candidates.

plans.name: Custom Pro
plans.notes: Quote-only. Includes all Business plan features plus dedicated account manager, API access, advanced reporting, SSL enforcement, and data export/import. Contact sales for pricing.

vendors.name: JazzHR
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page at jazzhr.com/pricing confirmed annual prices ($1,000/yr Hero, $3,480/yr Plus, $5,508/yr Pro) and stated 'save up to 24% by paying yearly'. Monthly prices ($99, $325, $499) confirmed by softwareadvice.com and getapp.com. Annual monthly equivalents computed from disclosed annual totals.

plans.name: Hero
plans.notes: Annual billing: $1,000/year ($83.33/month equivalent). Month-to-month: $99/month. Entry-level plan for getting started. Includes candidate alerts, resume database, job postings, and LinkedIn integration. Unlimited users.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Annual billing: $3,480/year ($290/month equivalent). Month-to-month: $325/month. Most popular plan. Adds auto-send emails, background checks, candidate reports, and interview scheduling. Unlimited users.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Annual billing: $5,508/year ($459/month equivalent). Month-to-month: $499/month. Highest tier for serious hiring. Adds custom reports, compliance tracking, e-signatures, and Zoom integration. Unlimited users.

vendors.name: BambooHR
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page at bamboohr.com/pricing returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch. Prices sourced from getapp.com and corroborated by softwareadvice.com, both of which list the same three tiers at identical per-user monthly rates: Core $10, Pro $17, Elite $25.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: $10 per employee/month. Includes HR data, reporting, hiring (ATS), onboarding, time-off tracking, benefits tracking, and integrations marketplace. Payroll, benefits administration, and time tracking available as paid add-ons.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $17 per employee/month. All Core features plus performance management, employee experience, employee rewards, and employee community.

plans.name: Elite
plans.notes: $25 per employee/month. All Pro features plus compensation management, custom dashboards and analytics, HR benchmarks, premium services, and BambooHR Marketplace access.

vendors.name: SmartRecruiters
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page at smartrecruiters.com/pricing confirmed Essential plan at 'Starting at $14,995' (annual) and three higher tiers as quote-only. getapp.com lists starting price as '$10,000 per feature/year'. The $14,995 annual figure from the official page is used as the Essential plan price.

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Starting at $14,995/year ($1,249.58/month equivalent), billed annually. Official page states 'Starting at' so actual price may be higher depending on company size. Includes ATS, CRM, onboarding, SMS messaging, job distribution, and dynamic scheduling.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Quote-only. Adds AI-powered Hiring Agent and AI Talent Matching Engine. Contact sales for pricing.

plans.name: High Volume
plans.notes: Quote-only. Most popular tier per vendor. Adds AI-powered candidate screening, conversational AI chat, and increased SMS and job distribution volume.

plans.name: Complete
plans.notes: Quote-only. Adds advanced analytics, advanced sandbox, and custom in-app guidance.
